name: Shinju no Moribito
source:
There are three worlds - Heaven, Underground and human one. Humans gets sandwiched between two warring factions as devils decide to crush humans and attack Heavens from there. The earthlings are ignorant about the other two worlds, so angels decide to plant sacred trees everywhere in human world and use their divine energy to exorcise evil. An angel guardian is appointed to protect these forests from destruction.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
世界由天界、冥界和人界構成。惡魔決心消滅人類，再以人界為跳板攻打天界，人類因此被夾在交戰的兩方之間。人類並不知道另外兩個世界的存在，於是天使決定在整個人界種下神樹，利用神樹的神聖力量驅除邪惡。天界還派出一位天使守護者，保護這些森林不被破壞。

［摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]］
